serotype_evidence.value: Reference-grade genome from FDA ARGOS BioProject PRJNA231221

curation.notes: FDA ARGOS isolate FDAARGOS_57. Serotype 1/2a confirmed in metadata. High-quality reference genome. Source: water.

reads.download_cmd: fasterq-dump --gzip --outdir data/ SRS891685 && mv data/SRS891685_1.fastq.gz data/reads_1.fq.gz && mv data/SRS891685_2.fastq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz

assembly.download_cmd: datasets download genome accession GCF_001188045.1 --filename data/FDAARGOS_57.zip && unzip -j data/FDAARGOS_57.zip '*.fna' -d data/ && mv data/*.fna data/contigs.fa

validation_instructions.serological: Expected serotype 1/2a. Serotype confirmed in FDA ARGOS metadata. Accept exact serotype match or grouped variants (e.g., 4b/4d/4e).

notes: FDA ARGOS L. monocytogenes isolate. Serotype 1/2a (Lineage II). Source: water. Run LisSero and mlst to complete typing.
